_comment: Versioned, repository-owned PROMOTE_SCOPE first-promotion bootstrap-authorization manifest. See native_short_promotion_bootstrap_evidence_v1.py for the full contract and docs/ops/native_short_sol_bootstrap_promotion_approval_v1.md for the reviewed human approval this manifest records. Authorizes exactly one PROMOTE_SCOPE for the SOL scope below, and only for a scope that has never before had any administration-ledger row (structurally single-use -- see native_short_scope_administration_transaction_v1._bootstrap_promotion_evidence_applies). It cannot be reused for ETH, XRP, BTC, or any other scope, and it cannot authorize a second promotion of SOL once the first succeeds. repository_commit_sha binds this authorization to one exact commit; a commit cannot state its own hash inside its own tree, so this value is filled in by a required, mechanical, reviewed follow-up commit once that exact commit's real hash is known -- see the approval doc for why, and note that until that follow-up commit exists and is checked out, this manifest fails every commit-match check closed, authorizing nothing.
